text_block_list.text:
One day, as I headed to Nakayama 
Racecourse, I saw some people I knew.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Hmm, so Nakayama Racecourse is...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. To me, it was a place of 
admiration, and to my grandmother, a place 
full of memories.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer. Good work! Were you watching?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Actually, along with Monthly Twinkle, 
several other media outlets have reached 
out to us too!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
In 8 minutes with 'Fever Turf WEB,' 25 
minutes after that with 'Nakayama Girl Up 
Close.' And 50 minutes after that...
choice_data_list: Isn't that cramming in a bit too much...?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine! I should at least be able to 
handle this much!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
The students are working so hard for this! 
We need to bring in an even bigger crowd 
for the next live show...!

Light Hello's resolve seems firm. Looking 
at her—
choice_data_list: I'll go buy some drinks for our break.

text_block_list.text:
Light Hello's resolve seems firm. Looking 
at her—
choice_data_list: I'll go buy some drinks for our break.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
! N-No way! I can do the shopping 
myself...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: *cough*... *cough*...

Light Hello's voice was a bit hoarse. It 
seems she had been overworking her throat 
since early this morning.
choice_data_list: I'll go buy some throat lozenges too.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...I-I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Phew... N-Ngh. *sigh*... I apologize for 
the trouble.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! I'm from "Passionate Turf WEB"—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! Thank you for having me! I'm Light 
Hello!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer. Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I promise I'll repay this favor someday! 
I'm sorry, excuse me!

The next day, a high-class assortment of 
sweets arrived as a gift for me and <chrname>.

Written on the gift wrapper in meticulous 
handwriting was the word "Thanks."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
……Eh. Are you sure? But you're off the 
clock, Trainer……
choice_data_list: I wanted to share their charm too.

I want to share their charm with everyone 
too.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
! My apologies! You're right... Trainer, 
you understand them much better than I do, 
and yet...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, I'm from "Fervent Turf," and 
I've arrived a little early...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I'm ready! Thank you for taking the time 
to interview me!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Um, and best regards to you too, Trainer!

And so, together with Light Hello, I 
handled the press interviews—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry for keeping you with me 
until this hour."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Still, you were amazing, Trainer. You had 
so much insightful feedback to give 
precisely because you're always watching 
over the students...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah! I've gotta do my best too!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"In tomorrow's interview, I'll answer the 
questions based on what you told me, 
Trainer!"
choice_data_list: You have an interview again tomorrow!?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Because I want to do everything I 
possibly can!

It turned into a day of being amazed by 
Light Hello's grit and passion for her 
work and project...
